Leverage is very high (total liabilities of 7,094M vs. total assets of 7,344M and shareholders’ equity of only 249M), which reduces balance-sheet resilience despite a reasonable current ratio (current assets 2,986M vs. current liabilities 1,678M).  

DECISION: CCC-
